## F — Sharing the Road
Research index: Sharing the Road; the main and continuation fact chunks contain 54 and 52 manually authored, page-anchored statements.
Physical-page coverage: 101 through 111, in handbook order.
VERIFY: ME-SEC10-COUNT — question count; ME-SEC10-PASS — passing standard; ME-SEC10-TIME — time limit.
VERIFY: ME-SEC10-MARKET — market pack; ME-SEC10-TEARDOWN — competitor teardown.
VERIFY: ME-SHARE-STATISTICS — Verify dates and populations for bicycle prevalence, motorcycle fatality/fleet figures and large-vehicle crash totals before numerical learner use.
VERIFY: ME-SHARE-VEHICLE-ASSUMPTIONS — Verify car/bicycle braking comparison, truck stopping and blind-zone distance examples, and drafting physics before universalized claims.
VERIFY: ME-SHARE-HELMET-STANDARDS — Verify current bicycle helmet standards, replacement instructions and under-sixteen public-way rule before current safety/legal signoff.
VERIFY: ME-SHARE-VISUAL-HANDEDNESS — Clarify bicycle signal photograph viewpoint/handedness before a new precise arm-side recognition claim; exact source pixels have been inspected.
VERIFY: ME-SHARE-LEGAL-SCOPE — Clarify midblock crossing wording, police-question legal scope and current move-over vehicle coverage; no universal fault or rights-waiver claim is exported.
Fact-check receipts in the worker scratch preserve all drafted fact ids and source-fidelity verdicts. Those same-model receipts do not substitute for independent QA.
